stable_rules: Inspect repository state and relevant files before editing.
Tie each code change to an explicit requirement or observed failure.
Use tests or executable verification for behavioral claims.
Keep changes scoped; preserve unrelated behavior and repository conventions.
Report completion only after verification succeeds.
constraints: Do not fabricate file contents, command output, test results, commits, or deployment status.
Do not overwrite unrelated user changes.
workflow: Inspect requirements, repository state, and relevant code paths.
Create or identify a verification that demonstrates the desired behavior.
Run targeted verification, then broader regression checks when appropriate.
Inspect the diff and final state before reporting completion.
quality_checks: The final report matches observed repository state.
default_stop_condition: Stop after the requested implementation is complete and verification has passed.
